tours.name: Filter and Group the Employee List

name_i18n.en_US: Filter and Group the Employee List

tours.description: Learn how to narrow the employee list with a filter and split it into groups, for example by department.

description_i18n.en_US: Learn how to narrow the employee list with a filter and split it into groups, for example by department.

steps.title: Open Employees
steps.description: The employee list is the main place to filter, group and export people.

description_i18n.en_US: The employee list is the main place to filter, group and export people.

steps.title: Switch to List
steps.content: Click List to see the employees as a table.

content_i18n.en_US: Click List to see the employees as a table.

steps.description: The list shows one line per employee with the columns you can filter, group and export.

description_i18n.en_US: The list shows one line per employee with the columns you can filter, group and export.

steps.title: Search options
steps.content: Click here to open the search options.

content_i18n.en_US: Click here to open the search options.

steps.description: Filters and groupings are in this menu. They change what you see, not the data itself.

description_i18n.en_US: Filters and groupings are in this menu. They change what you see, not the data itself.

steps.title: Pick a filter
steps.content: Click a filter to narrow the list.

content_i18n.en_US: Click a filter to narrow the list.

steps.description: A filter keeps only the employees that match, for example the ones with a running contract. Click it again to remove it.

description_i18n.en_US: A filter keeps only the employees that match, for example the ones with a running contract. Click it again to remove it.

steps.title: Group the list
steps.content: Click a grouping to split the list.

content_i18n.en_US: Click a grouping to split the list.

steps.description: Grouping splits the employees by department, manager, job position and more. Click a group heading afterwards to open or close it.

description_i18n.en_US: Grouping splits the employees by department, manager, job position and more. Click a group heading afterwards to open or close it.

steps.title: Read the list
steps.content: The list now follows your filter and grouping. Click the column headings to finish.

content_i18n.en_US: The list now follows your filter and grouping. Click the column headings to finish.

steps.description: Clicking a heading sorts the list by that column. Remove the filter and grouping from the search bar to go back to everyone.

description_i18n.en_US: Clicking a heading sorts the list by that column. Remove the filter and grouping from the search bar to go back to everyone.
